**Submitted: deviation (INDEMN), preferred level, redline validated (ok:true, minimality ok).**

**What the text already gives us (no edit made):**
- §11.2 — Harpoon "shall indemnify AbbVie, its Affiliates ... and defend and save each of them harmless" against Third Party Claims → defence duty, affiliates, third-party claims.
- §11.3 — prompt written Indemnification Claim Notice → notice.
- §11.4.1 — indemnifying party may assume the defence, with AbbVie controlling on failure to assume (§11.4.2) → control allocation.
- §11.4.4 — cooperation in the defence, records, witnesses → cooperation.

**What failed and how it is repaired in operative language:**
1. *Op 2 (into §11.2)* — an additive "Without limiting the foregoing ... include" list supplying the four missing Harpoon-side triggers: third-party IP infringement/misappropriation claims against the Licensed Compounds, Licensed Products or licensed IP; Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law; Harpoon-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of AbbVie Confidential Information or data; Harpoon's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Framing it as additive preserves whatever sits behind the "[***]" rather than duplicating or overwriting it, and it slots into the retained architecture instead of creating a free-standing indemnity paragraph.
2. *Op 1 (into §11.1)* — one sentence limiting our own indemnity to Third Party Claims arising from AbbVie-provided content or materials and AbbVie's breach of Applicable Law.

**Deliberately not added:** the fallback 3× annual-fees super-cap. Harpoon's indemnity is presently uncapped (§11.5 restricts only consequential damages), so importing the cap would be a self-inflicted concession. Procure/modify/replace and refund remedies likewise belong only to the fallback level and are not required at the preferred target selected here.
